name: Destroy the Wall
detailed_description:
Enter the Forsaken World

Venture into a desolate land where every step of progress must be earned through struggle. At every step of the way, see new beauties, uncover new mysteries, and hone your skill at a uniquely challenging one-of-a-kind experience. Forge your own path through a great maze of caverns, shafts, tunnels, windswept plains, and ruined forests. Journey further forward—as stopping means death, you have no other choice. Find ancient artifacts that carry both powers and memories. Hear the messages of the wall’s master. Defy him, and make your way through its ramparts and towers. Are you ready for what’s at the top? 

Core mechanics

  • Your character always follows your cursor

  • If your character and cursor touch, you will take damage

  • If your character runs into a wall, you will take damage

  • The character and cursor share a health pool. If they run out of health, you die

  • After dying, you respawn at the start of the current room, only seconds back

  • Monsters move throughout the world and will try to hurt you in unique ways

  • Typically, monsters damage you by either directly hitting your cursor, or using attacks to hurt your cursor from afar

  • Hitting an enemy with your character damages it, and deflects your character backwards

  • As you progress, you can learn additional ways to damage monsters

  • Killing monsters grants EXP, which can increase things like health, damage, and acceleration

Game features

  • Tight action gameplay filled with tactical decision making 

  • Expressive hand-drawn art for all sprites and levels with a deliberately janky aesthetic 

  • A sometimes brooding, sometimes epic soundtrack to echo your journey through an unforgiving world

  • Over 400 perilous levels, spread out across twelve mechanically and visually unique areas

  • 40+ monsters with unique attack patterns, from giant swords that swing to attack you, to organs of pollution that drown you in clouds of smoke, to friendly hearts that share the gift of love with you (this gift is delivered in the form of a deadly laser)

  • Thirteen gripping boss fights

  • One Wall, to be destroyed

  • Choose your own level of suffering! Difficulties range from “Painkiller” to “Everything hurts

  • Squeeze through perilous passageways 

  • Find fragments of the past scattered throughout the world, and internalize them to gain new powers and open new paths

  • Discover [REDACTED]’s [REDACTED]s

short_description: 2D metroidvainia action with a unique control scheme. Guide a snake chasing your cursor--but don't let them touch. Explore the mysterious Forsaken World, navigate through its decay, and learn to fight in a completely new way. Perservere and destroy the Wall that's always been holding you back.

  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics or AMD (formerly ATI) Radeon HD Graphics (Discrete): Nvidia GeForce 9600 GT or AMD Radeon HD 2400 or better
  • Sound Card: Any
